plan.title: Liver 3-group DE: LRT any-difference + pairwise vs control
plan.analytical_narrative: Data: 12,000-gene x 12-sample raw Salmon gene-level counts for human liver, 3 groups (control, treated_a, treated_b) x 4 replicates, unpaired, single batch. Research question has two parts: (1) which genes differ across the three groups at all, and (2) which genes does each treatment change relative to control. This maps directly onto the DESeq2 LRT-then-Wald workflow the knowledge base recommends for a 3+ group, replicated, no-batch design: fit ~condition vs ~1 with the LRT to answer the omnibus 'differs at all' question, then extract two named Wald contrasts (treated_a vs control, treated_b vs control) with the reference level of condition set explicitly to control, to answer the per-treatment question. LFC is shrunk with ashr (contrasts, not single coefficients, require ashr rather than apeglm). BH-FDR with independent filtering is applied within each contrast/test. Sample-structure QC (blind VST, PCA, sample distance heatmap) precedes the model to catch outliers/batch structure before trusting the fit. Per-contrast preranked fgsea enrichment (rank by Wald statistic) against MSigDB Hallmark (confirmed present, human, 2026.1) with Reactome and WikiPathways human follow-up (both confirmed present) closes the loop from gene lists to pathways. Every step stays on this dataset's actual condition names and this study's design; no cell-type, immune, or drug-repurposing angle is invoked because the research question and data context give no such signal.

steps.method: Minimal pre-filter: >=10 counts in >= smallest group size (4)
~condition, reference=control, named contrasts treated_a vs control and treated_b vs control
DESeq2 LRT (full ~condition vs reduced ~1) for any-group-difference, then pairwise Wald contrasts (treated_a vs control, treated_b vs control)
ashr shrinkage on each pairwise Wald contrast
Benjamini-Hochberg with independent filtering, alpha=0.05, within each contrast
fgsea preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic, per contrast, MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome/WikiPathways follow-up
Integrated report: QC diagnostics, LRT any-difference gene list, pairwise DE tables, enrichment tables, reproducibility record
